book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Kaaleththidikka Yesusi «Ta inttes tuma gays; hayssan eqqida asaappe Xoossa kawoteththi wolqqara yishin beyana gakkanaas hayqqontta gam7ana issi issi asati deettes» gides.
Yesusa Medha Laameteth
Usuppun gallassafe guye Yesusi Phexroosa, Yaaqoobenne Yohannisa banara kaaleththi ekkidi issi gita zuma bolla kezides. Istti barkka dishin istta sinththan iza medhay laametti wodhdhides.
Izi may7ida may7oy biitta bolla oonikka may7o meeccidi hessa mala booththanaas dandayontta booth boottides.
He wode Eelaasinne Musey Yesusara haasayettishe isttas beettida.
Phexroosi Yesusa, «Astamaaree! Nuni haan hayssan dizaakko nuus lo7o; nees issi daase, Muses issi daase, qasse Eelaasas issi daase, heedzdzu daaseta nu ooththikochchii?» gides.
Daro babbida gishshas Phexroosi ba gizayssa eridi gibeenna.
Heerakka shaaray istta kammiin shaara giddora, «Hayssi ta dosiza ta naazakko! Izi gizaa siyite» giza qaala giirissi yides.
Heerakka istti yuushshi xeelliin Yesusappe attiin oonikka hara asi isttara deenna.
Istti zuma bollafe duge wodhdhishin Asa Nay hayqoppe dendana gakkanaas hayssa istti be7idayssa oonaska yootontta mala azazides.
Isttika baas yootida qaala ba wozinan oykkida shin, «Hayqoppe dendo guussi ay guussee?» giidi ba giddon haasayettida.
Qasse istti Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti, «Kasetidi Eelaasi yaana koshshees aazas gizoo?» giidi iza oychchida.
Yesusi isttas, «Tumukka Eelaasi kaseti yiidi wursika giigsana. Histtiinkka Asa Nay daro waaye ekkanaassinne kadhettanaas bessees geetetti xaafettidayssi inttes ay misatizee?
Gido attiin ta inttes gizay Eelaasi gidikko yides shin asaykka iza gishshas xaafettida mala bana koshshida mala iza bolla ooththides» gides.
Yesusi Iita Ayanappe Paththida Naaza
Geedon attida Yesusa kaallizaytakko istti simmi yishin daro asay istta giddoththiin Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti isttara palamettizayssa be7ida.
Derey iza demmida mala malalettidi sarokkanaas izakko woxxides.
Izikka istta, «Intte isttara aaza gishshas palameteetii?» giidi oychchides.
Asaa giddofe issaadey, «Astamaaree! Tuna ayanay izan geliin doona duudida ta naa dayssa ta neekko ekka yadis.

Ayanazi dendiza wode bollafe yeggees; doonara goppontto kessi kessi yeggees; achchaaka garccees; asateththaaka zoodisees; tuna ayana kessetto gaada nena kaallizayta ta yootiin isttika dandaybeettenna» gides.
Yesusikka isttas zaaridi, «Intteno ammanontta yeletatoo, ayde gakkanaas ta inttenara daanee? Qasse ayde gakkanaas ta inttena dandayanee? Ane naaza haa ehite» gides.
Asaykka naaza izakko ehides, tuna ayanay Yesusa be7ida mala naaza heerakka gaden genderisidi kokkorisidinne doonara goppontto coppu histtides.
Yesusi naaza aawaa, «Hayssi hargey iza ayidesappe oykkidee?» gides. Naaza aawaykka, «Naateththafe doommidi» gides.
«Iza wodhanaas koyidi daro wode tamankka haaththankka yeggees. Nees dandayettiko nuus mishettanne nuna maadda» gides.
Yesusi qasse, « ‹Nees dandayettiko› gay? Ammanizaades wurikka dandayettees» gides.
Naaza aaway heerakka, «Ta ammanays shin ta ammanoy laafa, tana maaddarkkii!» giidi waassides.
Asay wocamishe buuretti ekkidi izakko yizayssa Yesusi be7idi, «Haysso tullenne duude ayanazoo! Hayssa naazappe keza, ne qasse simmada gelontta mala ta nena azazays» giidi tuna ayanaa seerides.
Tuna ayanazikka keehi waassides; naazikka keehi qakettidaappe guye naazappe kezides. Daroti hayqqides gaana gakkanaas naazi aha misatides.
Gido attiin Yesusi naaza kushe oykki denththides; naazikka dendi eqqides.
Yesusi soo gelidaappe guye iza kaallizayti, «Nu izappe tuna ayana kessanaas aazas dandaybeekkonii?» giidi iza oychchida.
Izikka isttas, «Hayssa malay kezana dandayzay woosaninne xooman xalla» gides.
Yesusi Ba Hayqo Gishshassinne Ba Dendo Gishshas Qasseka Yootides
Heeppe dendidi Galila baggara aadhdhi bida; Yesusi ba dizaso oonikka erana mala koyibeenna.
Gaasoykka Yesusi bana kaallizaytas, «Asa Nay asa kushen aadhdhi imettana; isttika iza wodhana, heedzdzanththo gallassafe guye izi dendana» giidi istta tamaarsiza gishshassa.
Gido attiin izi gizayssi isttas gelibeenna; iza oychchanaaska babbida.
Ubbaafe Aadhdhizay Oonee?
Hessafe guye Qifirnahoome bida; izi keeththe gelidi, «Intte yishe oge bolla aaza gishshas palamettidetii?» gi oychchides.
Istti qasse oge bolla, «Nu giddon nuuppe ubbaafe aadhdhizay oonee?» giidi palamettida gishshas wurikka co7u gida.
Izi uttidaappe guye tammanne nam7ata xeygidi, «Koyro gidana koyzaadey ubbaafe wurseththinne ubbatas ashkara gido» gides.
Qii guuththa naa ehidi istta giddon essides. Idimmidi,
«Hayta guuththa naytappe issaade ta sunththan mokki ekkizaadey tanakka mokki ekkees; tana mokki ekkizaadey wuri tana xalala gidontta tana kiittidayssaka mokki ekkees» gides.
Nuna Ixxonttay Wuri Nu Bagga
Yohannisikka, «Astamaaree! Issaadey ne sunththan daydanth kessishin nu beydos. Izi nuna kaallontta gishshas kessontta mala diggidos» gides.
Yesusi qasse, «Diggofte; oonikka ta sunththan malaata ooththidi eesotidi ta bolla iita haasayanaas dandayenna.
Nunara eqettonttay wuri nunara dees.
Ta inttes tumu gays; intte tiyettida Kirstoosas gidida gishshas ta sunththan issi wanca haath inttena ushshidaadey wuri ba oosoys waaga dhayenna.
Asas Dhuphe Gidanaappe Naageteth
«Hayta tana ammaniza ha guuththatappe issaades dhuphe gidizay wuri deexo woxa shuchchi iza qoodhen qashettiin duge abba gido olettidaakko izas lo7o gidana.
Hessa gishshas ne kushey nena baleththiko neeppe qanxxa yegga; nam7u kushera daada gede Gaanname taman ne baanayssafe kushe duuxa gidada gede de7on geloy nees lo7o gidana.
Gaannamen guxuney hayqqenna, tamaynne to7enna.
Nena ne tohoy baleththiko neeppe qanxxa digga; nam7u tohora daada gede Gaanname tamaan yegettanaappe ne wobbe gidada gede de7oso geloy nees lo7o.
Gaannamen guxuney hayqqenna, tamaynne to7enna.
Nena ne ayfey baleththiko wooca kessada neeppe digga; nam7u ayfera daada gede Gaannamen yegettanaappe issi ayfera Xoossa Kawoteth geloy nees lo7o.
Gaannamen guxuney hayqqenna tamaynne to7enna.
«Buro asi wuri taman paacettana.
«Maxiney lo7o; gido attiin maxiney ba maxineteththaa yeddiko intte wostti iza mal7o eranee? Intte asateththan maxiney de7o. Intte intte giddon dosettite» gides.
